# Third-party notices: ALONE browser engine

Generated from [storyxy3/ALONE](https://github.com/storyxy3/ALONE/tree/1a49f794c93625c1c8f42f8ae68d37db31aa1ecd)
with the local cross-role body patch recorded in SOURCE_MANIFEST.json.
Upstream author: storyxy3 and contributors. The pinned repository does not
declare a project-level license; this package does not relabel it as MIT or
grant a new license. It contains no Uni-PJSK-Viewer application source.

The separately extracted Project SEKAI shader programs and game runtime assets
remain proprietary game materials: © SEGA / © Colorful Palette Inc. /
© Crypton Future Media, INC. and their respective rights holders. Game model,
motion and texture bundles are loaded from the configured original store and
are not included in this vendor directory.
